title: Dependency-Aware Semi-Structured Sparsity: Declining Roles of Outliers in Pruning GLU-based LLMs
selection_reason: DaSS prunes GLU-based LLMs (LLaMA2/Mistral/Gemma) with a dependency-aware semi-structured metric combining weight magnitude and MLP intermediate activation norms, explicitly targeting serving memory size and token-generation latency with hardware-friendly N:M sparsity patterns outperforming SparseGPT and Wanda.
